# SheetJS Community Edition

The offline Excel reader is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 full browser build.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Official installation and vendoring instructions: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: `SheetJS-LICENSE.txt` (Apache License 2.0), downloaded from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
- Downloaded script SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`

The app reads local `.xlsx` files with this bundled script. It never downloads code or uploads a roster during use.
